searchText: Is it possible to remove embeds from Discord on mobile? Surround your link with angle brackets in the message like this: `<https://ethereum.org>`. Oh thanks! I'll stop polluting channels when I'm on the cell https://np.reddit.com/r/EtherMining/comments/n1aw9u/when_god_gives_you_one_chance_to_save_your_sweet/ if there are any miners here please have safety mechanisms in place yep found one outlet in my bedroom melting when I unplugged and one 12 gauge cable was somehow charring despite it only running 1400w. Its a dangerous passion. Hi <@!552133098075193354>, just wanted to know how the client implementation for London going on? Do we see any major roadblocks as of today? We discussed it on AllCoreDevs this AM, but no major roadblocks, lots of testing underway 👍 https://twitter.com/lightclients/status/1387495468549160971 I just noticed this on twitter Thanks! the network is at 100% capacity, 100% of the day, and there's like 151k pending tx's ... wouldn't this make fees go exponential? 10 mins of full blocks = 10x (say 10 gwei), 20 mins => 100x (100 gwei), 30 mins => 1000x (1000 gwei?) this reminds me of the 'direct incentives' used in fei protocol, and they had to stop them within 3 days cos nobody dared using it cos they'd get rekt It will make it go "exponential" until we reach the market price post-1559, blocks can be up to 200% full and the `BASE FEE` only goes up if they are >100% full so assume the market price for gas is 100 gwei, we hard fork and the `BASE FEE` is 1 gwei For ~10 minutes, you will have 200% full blocks as the `BASE FEE` goes up 100x but at 100 gwei, the demand for blockspace will be equivalent to 100% of the gas limit, so the base fee will stay stable (and if demand increases, then the base fee goes up, same for decrease/down) Worth noting that the reason we have so many pending txns now is that we don't have a market price in the protocol so post-1559, we can better know what the demand is at a certain price and transaction who are not willing to pay that price don't really need to be "pending" (they still can, but it's clear in the protocol that they are very unlikely to be included in the next N blocks) Can users still bid at whatever tx fee they want? Well, each block specifies the minimum price you need to pay to be included, that's what the `BASE FEE` is users specify the max they are willing to pay (`FEE CAP`), and get refunded the difference between their max and the base fee + miner tip so for example, if the base fee is 100, and you want to give a 5 gwei miner tip, and put a fee cap of 200, you will get back 200-100-5=95 gwei so if your fee cap is < than the base fee, then your transaction cannot be included in the block but the base fee could lower in the next block if there is low demand, so in that sense you can still "bid", but it's basically betting on demand lowering Maybe I don't have the full picture. My bad. Thanks <@!552133098075193354> No worries! There are a bunch of explainers for the EIP here: https://hackmd.io/@timbeiko/1559-resources It dfefinitely takes a while to build the full picture 😅 Did London block numbers get decided today or is that one for next ACD call? Next ACD call 👍 When is next ACD call? Two weeks from today, 14:00 UTC

excerpts.author: timbeiko

excerpts.author: timbeiko
